additional_info.subject: 0444386 - ID0444386-DC/Si-D/SA-[MP / N0 170000002] Charger Is Stuck CRM:00314000221
additional_info.body:
Good morning colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of
ID0444386
for charger
MP/N0 170000002
. The ticket has been opened from end customer, reporting that the screen is frozen and not responsive.
I checked on SCB, and the charger is offline and not producing error flags or logs. I suspect therefore that the FW has been somehow corrupted. Therefore, the next steps to be followed are:
Ask the customer to go onsite and
urgently switch off the charger as soon as possible.
In the past weeks, we faced some issues with chargers that got the FW corrupted, went offline, but after a while they started to produce logs non-stop.
It does not seem the case of this charger, but it would be important to avoid any spamming of logs. So please, advise the end customer to switch off the charger as soon as possible.
Second step is to organize an onsite visit to:
Retrieve the dump logs from the charger
Flash the CFast card of the charger and restore its operational status
Please be aware that the charger is currently out of warranty.
I am moving case 0444386 ﻿from the
Expert Services Team
to the
eMobility RC-SA SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Onsite visit required.
Charger out of warranty.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-SA SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
